desktop-login.note: The mark in sound: ··· ——— ··· at 50 ms per Morse unit. First S on A5, the O as three warm E5 tones, the last S climbing A5–C♯6–E6 and ringing out: an A-major greeting, never a distress beep.

desktop-logout.note: C♯6 · A5 · E5 — the greeting folded back down; the last note long and soft.

message-new-instant.note: One soft tick on E6 with an E5 undertone. The only notification sound.

bell.note: Terminal/console bell: a short, round E5, darker than a notification.

complete.note: A job finished: E5–A5–E6, three quick rising notes.

dialog-warning.note: Two even E5 blips: attention, not alarm.

device-added.note: Plugged in: E5 → B5, a rising fifth.

device-removed.note: Unplugged: B5 → E5, the same fifth falling.

audio-volume-change.note: A 70 ms C♯6 tick that repeats cleanly while the volume moves; 3 dB quieter than the rest.

camera-shutter.note: Two filtered noise clicks 75 ms apart with a soft body: a small leaf shutter.

screen-capture.note: A short airy sweep and an E6 ping: the screen was captured.

jackson-listen.note: Jackson starts listening: E5 → A5, rising fourth, quick.

jackson-done.note: Jackson finished: A5 → E5, the listening motif turned down.

jackson-error.note: Jackson could not do it: A4 → E4, a low, dark double.

jackson-thinking.note: Optional: an almost inaudible A6 tick for long waits (−32 LUFS).
